summary: Tested new HR management features: 1) Employee Self-Service Dashboard Widgets (Customize dialog, Upcoming Holidays, Monthly Attendance Summary, localStorage persistence) and 2) Team Org Chart Visualization (stats bar, search, expand/collapse, tree nodes, department badges). Backend: 10/10 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified via Playwright.

Backend: Widget-data has upcoming_holidays array with 4+ holidays
Backend: Widget-data has team_birthdays array
